venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Friday 1/9.** Smooth evening. A 10 top at 10pm was underwhelming; many enthusiasts throughout; good to see Alex (Frost). Room full-ish at last call, everyone out by 2:15. Comps $290.24 (DNLs, investors). Top sellers: First Time Listener, Masari, Year of the Trees/Material Control (tie). Door: fun, busy night for dry January; usual line outside, mild weather with folks coatless, long waitlist of twos, birthdays galore, a bar-hop bingo pair, used standing room when needed. 1 no-show (Samantha Solis @ 11pm). Kitchen: none.

venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Friday 1/9.** Garden: very slow, a few 2/3-tops early; opening bartender and host cut at 9pm; Garden last call 10:30 and closed by 11pm to refocus on Marquee. D&C: slow start; once the Garden closed the whole room sat, including larger groups and date-night couples. Some double rings, missed orders, pre-bussing and table-timing communication gaps to tighten. Hit daily sales target. Kitchen: 12.54% of sales; James ran the kitchen solo and a large wave of tickets hit at once, a few items comped for long ticket times. MOD: Kevin / Cory / Josh.
